# grey_usu self-fix (GR.20) -- re-declare three USU port companies whose TRY_INJECT:: (two colons) prefix never loaded
# Generated by tools/regen_greys_usu_fix.py on 2026-08-27. Do not hand-edit: the
# next run overwrites this file. Change the generator instead.
#
# Load order: grey_usu -> ... -> THIS (anywhere after grey_usu; internal to
# grey_usu, no other mod involved).
# Why this file exists: yMoG_USU_companies_ports_overwrite.txt has a typo'd prefix on three of its records -- `TRY_INJECT::company_X` (two colons) where every sibling record in the same file has `TRY_INJECT:company_X` (one). The engine does not recognise `WORD::` as a prefix at all, so these three records are not loaded -- not overridden, not skipped-with-a-warning, simply never parsed as the intended statement. Nothing in error.log. The three companies (John Holt and Company, Lanfang Kongsi, Society of Putilov Factories) end up missing the building_river_port (and, for Putilov, the building_usu_railway_line prosperity modifier) that every other company in the file gets. Internal to grey_usu, no other mod involved -- fixed here so the compatch does not have to wait on any particular pair, and reported to the author.

# Same three bodies as yMoG_USU_companies_ports_overwrite.txt, prefix fixed
# from `TRY_INJECT::` (two colons, never loads) to `TRY_INJECT:` (one):
#   company_john_holt
#   company_lanfang_kongsi
#   company_putilov_company
